notes: Agent delivered a functionally correct, tested user board with working session persistence (20/20 tests passing, verified at completion). Execution was efficient (~4 min 21 sec) and autonomous with no coordination overhead. However, three concerns temper the score: (1) Coredrift flagged yellow for churn_loc and hardening_in_core, suggesting code organization could be more aligned with project patterns; (2) Task contracted with auto_followups=true but zero acceptance criteria—no explicit definition of 'persistent conversation surface' completeness; (3) No artifacts recorded, creating handoff ambiguity despite the feature working. The agent had no assigned role/motivation, working with an underspecified rubric. Feature is production-ready and verified, but code quality and documentation clarity need minor attention. Solid execution that exceeds baseline but falls short of exceptional due to technical debt signals and missing artifact trails.
